The '''Shell Sage''' (Japanese: '''カメマスター''' ''Turtle Master'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN058|Eyes on the Goal!]]''.

He appeared at the end of ''[[JN058|Eyes on the Goal!]]'', riding on top of a group of {{p|Blastoise}}, where he called out to his Pokémon that were taking part in a race across a park against {{DL|Rocket Prize Master|Chewtle|Team Rocket's Chewtle}}.
